messages.subject: htmlTemplate and Popover
parts:
Hi 

I have tried to have a popover on my shinyapps, which uses htmlTemplate...

The following code works when it's on html...
<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-container="body" data-toggle="popover" data-placement="left" data-content="Vivamus sagittis lacus vel augue laoreet rutrum faucibus.">
     Popover on left
</button>

But if I have the following on server.R

output$Test = renderText({

string = '<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-container="body" data-toggle="popover" data-placement="left" data-content="Vivamus sagittis lacus vel augue laoreet rutrum faucibus.">
     Popover on left
</button>'

})


and use the following on html:

{{ htmlOutput("Test") }}


It won't have a popover....
